self_contained_context.background: Character is the core domain entity in this turn-based combat simulator. Two characters fight until one reaches 0 HP. Character must be immutable (frozen dataclass) to prevent state mutation bugs and demonstrate functional programming paradigm in the live demo.

business_rules.immutability: Character is a value object - any state change returns a NEW Character instance. Original instance remains unchanged. This prevents action-at-a-distance bugs.
business_rules.derived_agility: Agility = HP + Attack Power. This is COMPUTED (property), not stored. Demonstrates derived properties that automatically update when base values change.
business_rules.validation: Name cannot be empty, HP cannot be negative, Attack Power must be positive. Business invariants enforced in __post_init__.
business_rules.hp_flooring: HP never goes negative. When receiving damage, HP floors at 0 (character dead).
business_rules.liveness: Character is alive if HP > 0, dead if HP = 0.

architecture_context.dependencies: ZERO external dependencies - pure Python dataclass
architecture_context.testability: 100% testable in isolation, no mocking required

character_attributes.name: String identifier for the character (non-empty)
character_attributes.hp: Current hit points (>= 0). Character dies when HP reaches 0.
character_attributes.attack_power: Base damage dealt per attack (> 0). Added to dice roll for total damage.
character_attributes.agility: DERIVED PROPERTY (not stored). Calculated as hp + attack_power. Used for initiative rolls.
